visual_action: A fast-paced montage shows diverse groups of campaign supporters and staff in an office setting. They are enthusiastically holding up campaign signs, banners, and wearing sweatshirts for the 'HARRIS WALZ' ticket. People are smiling and pointing, surrounded by campaign posters and an American flag.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Her face is shown on a large campaign poster on a wall, and her name appears on numerous signs, banners, and apparel (e.g., 'HARRIS WALZ', 'KAMALA').

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: His name is featured prominently on campaign materials alongside Kamala Harris, reading 'HARRIS WALZ'.

cast.name: Unnamed campaign supporters/staff
cast.evidence: Multiple unidentified individuals are shown throughout the video holding campaign signs and wearing merchandise.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: His name appears on a poster in the background that reads 'JOE BIDEN & KAMALA HARRIS THE DEMOCRATS'.

on_screen_text.text: A Woman's Place is in the House
JOE BIDEN & KAMALA HARRIS THE DEMOCRATS

spoken_summary: An upbeat song with a female vocalist repeatedly asks, "Did you vote? Are you gonna vote? Will you vote for me?"
audio_music: An energetic, upbeat hip-hop/dance track plays throughout the video, featuring a female vocalist singing a get-out-the-vote message. The effect is motivational and creates a sense of hype.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage with very fast cuts, with each shot lasting only about one second, creating a high-energy and dynamic feel.
central_claim: The Harris/Walz campaign has energetic and diverse support, and viewers should join the movement by voting for them.
intended_effect: To generate excitement for the Harris/Walz ticket and motivate viewers to vote.
